sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Market breadth is exceptionally narrow with only Financials achieving all-green status, while a slip in Technology and fragility in Financials signal underlying divergence.

The US equity sectors are exhibiting highly concentrated leadership. Financials (momentum 0.65) is the sole group out of 11 to achieve "all-green" status across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD timeframes. Industrials also shows sustained strength, maintaining its position in the top three across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. Energy has edged up to take the number one rank (momentum 0.53), while Healthcare and Financials also posted minor rank improvements.

Conversely, momentum is fading at the top. Technology has slipped from its peak, dropping one spot to rank 2 despite maintaining a high momentum score of 0.817. Laggards continue to drag, led by Communication Services, which fell two spots to rank 10 (momentum 0.233), and Consumer Cyclical, which remains anchored at the bottom of the board at rank 11 (momentum 0.117).

## Strength
* **Financials:** The single "all-green" sector across all measured timeframes (weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD) with a momentum score of 0.65.
* **Industrials:** Demonstrates sustained strength as a top-three performer across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows, carrying a robust momentum score of 0.733.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Energy:** Led the gainers by climbing +1 spot to capture the #1 rank, supported by a momentum score of 0.53.
* **Technology:** Remains the overall momentum leader at 0.817 (YTD rank 2), but lost ground by dropping -1 spot over the last five sessions.
* **Communication Services:** Marked the largest decline, falling -2 spots to rank 10 with a weak momentum score of 0.233.
* **Consumer Cyclical:** Continues to underperform as the primary market laggard, sitting at rank 11 with a momentum score of just 0.117.

## Divergences
* **Technology Fading:** Showing early signs of exhaustion as its short-term rank slipped by -1 over the last five days despite its leading 0.82 momentum score.
* **Fragile Financials:** Although Financials is the only all-green sector, its leadership is highly fragile with a low agreement score of 0.34.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Heavy industrial machinery and tech hardware maintain a firm grip on market leadership, while precious metals and defensive sectors suffer a sharp weekly retreat.

Market breadth remains highly concentrated, with only 15 of 144 industry groups achieving "all-green" status across all timeframes. Heavy industrials and technology hardware continue to lead the charge, spearheaded by Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (momentum 0.94) and Electrical Equipment & Parts (momentum 0.92). Meanwhile, we are seeing a notable weekly rotation into Biotechnology (+21 spots) and Banks - Diversified (+14 spots), with the latter securing a spot on the all-green list.

Conversely, commodity-linked and defensive sectors are fading rapidly. Precious metals have suffered a severe weekly pullback, with Silver dropping 29 spots and Gold falling 22 spots. Traditional defensive areas like Grocery Stores (-24 spots, momentum 0.11) are also under pressure. Furthermore, early-warning signals show momentum-heavy cyclical areas like Steel and Copper beginning to slip in rank despite their strong medium-term profiles.

## Strength
* **Narrow Breadth:** Only 15 out of 144 industry groups are "all-green" (positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD), highlighting highly concentrated market leadership.
* **Industrial & Tech Dominance:** Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (momentum 0.94) and Electrical Equipment & Parts (0.92) anchor the top of the momentum curve alongside Computer Hardware (0.90).
* **Sustained Leadership:** REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.91) and Textile Manufacturing (momentum 0.83) join heavy machinery as consistently strong performers across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Biotechnology surged 21 spots to rank 64 (momentum 0.74), followed closely by Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+15 spots) and Banks - Diversified (+14 spots to rank 48).
* **Severe Decliners:** Commodity-related groups fell sharply over the last five sessions, led by Silver (-29 spots, rank 66), Coking Coal (-26 spots, rank 107), and Gold (-22 spots, rank 110).
* **Bottom Laggards:** Software - Application (momentum 0.11, rank YTD 141) and Information Technology Services (momentum 0.08, rank YTD 139) remain deeply entrenched at the bottom of the market.

## Divergences
* **Fading Cyclicals:** Steel (momentum 0.68) and Copper (momentum 0.67) are showing early signs of exhaustion, slipping 8 and 4 spots respectively over the last 5 sessions despite their high momentum scores.
* **Emerging Bottom-Fishers:** Several low-momentum groups are jumping in rank, indicating potential early rotation, including Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+15 spots, momentum 0.45) and Credit Services (+11 spots, momentum 0.46).
* **Consumer Slippage:** Lodging (momentum 0.68, rank -5) and Department Stores (momentum 0.61, rank -3) are beginning to lose ground despite otherwise healthy momentum profiles.
